verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הָרְבִיעִ֔ת לִיהוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הָיָ֞ה הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מֵאֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî baš·šā·nāh hā·rə·ḇî·‘iṯ lî·hō·w·yā·qîm ben- yō·šî·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh hā·yāh had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū mê·’êṯ Yah·weh lê·mōr
verses.literal: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah . . . this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD
verses.literalPt: No quarto ano de Jeoaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, veio da parte de Jeová esta palavra a Jeremias, dizendo:

verses.original: קַח־ לְךָ֮ מְגִלַּת־ סֵפֶר֒ וְכָתַבְתָּ֣ אֵלֶ֗יהָ אֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֞ים אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֧רְתִּי אֵלֶ֛יךָ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל וְעַל־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וְעַל־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם מִיּ֞וֹם דִּבַּ֤רְתִּי אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ מִימֵ֣י יֹאשִׁיָּ֔הוּ וְעַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qaḥ- lə·ḵā mə·ḡil·laṯ- sê·p̄er wə·ḵā·ṯaḇ·tā ’ê·le·hā ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer- dib·bar·tî ’ê·le·ḵā ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl wə·‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·‘al- kāl- hag·gō·w·yim mî·yō·wm dib·bar·tî ’ê·le·ḵā mî·mê yō·šî·yā·hū wə·‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: Take a scroll . . . and write on it all the words I have spoken to you concerning Israel . . . Judah . . . and all the nations from the day I first spoke to you during the reign of Josiah until today . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Toma o rolo dum livro, e nele escreve todas as palavras que te hei falado contra Israel, e contra Judá e contra todas as nações, desde o dia em que te falei, desde os dias de Josias até o dia de hoje.

verses.original: אוּלַ֤י יִשְׁמְעוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י חֹשֵׁ֖ב לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָהֶ֑ם לְמַ֣עַן יָשׁ֗וּבוּ אִ֚ישׁ מִדַּרְכּ֣וֹ הָרָעָ֔ה וְסָלַחְתִּ֥י לַעֲוֺנָ֖ם וּלְחַטָּאתָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ū·lay yiš·mə·‘ū bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh ’êṯ kāl- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî ḥō·šêḇ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lā·hem lə·ma·‘an yā·šū·ḇū ’îš mid·dar·kōw hā·rā·‘āh wə·sā·laḥ·tî la·‘ă·wō·nām ū·lə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām
verses.literal: Perhaps when the people of Judah hear about all the calamity I plan to bring upon them . . . each of them will turn from his wicked way Then I will forgive their iniquity and their sin
verses.literalPt: Talvez ouçam os da casa de Judá todo o mal que eu intento fazer-lhes; de modo que se tornem cada um do seu mau caminho, a fim de que eu perdoe a sua iniquidade e o seu pecado.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֶת־ בָּר֖וּךְ בֶּן־ נֵֽרִיָּ֑ה וַיִּכְתֹּ֨ב בָּר֜וּךְ מִפִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ אֵ֣ת כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלָ֖יו עַל־ מְגִלַּת־ סֵֽפֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā yir·mə·yā·hū ’eṯ- bā·rūḵ ben- nê·rî·yāh way·yiḵ·tōḇ bā·rūḵ mip·pî yir·mə·yā·hū ’êṯ kāl- diḇ·rê Yah·weh ’ă·šer- dib·ber ’ê·lāw ‘al- mə·ḡil·laṯ- sê·p̄er
verses.literal: So Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah and at the dictation of Jeremiah Baruch wrote on a scroll . . . all the words that the LORD had spoken to Jeremiah
verses.literalPt: Chamou Jeremias a Baruque, filho de Nerias; e da boca de Jeremias escreveu Baruque, no rolo dum livro, todas as palavras de Jeová, que ele lhe havia falado.

verses.original: וַיְצַוֶּ֣ה יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֶת־ בָּר֖וּךְ לֵאמֹ֑ר אֲנִ֣י עָצ֔וּר לֹ֣א אוּכַ֔ל לָב֖וֹא בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw·weh yir·mə·yā·hū ’eṯ- bā·rūḵ lê·mōr ’ă·nî ‘ā·ṣūr lō ’ū·ḵal lā·ḇō·w bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then Jeremiah commanded Baruch . . . I am restricted I cannot . . . enter the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Jeremias ordenou a Baruque, dizendo: Eu estou encarcerado; não posso entrar na casa de Jeová.

verses.original: וּבָאתָ֣ אַתָּ֡ה וְקָרָ֣אתָ בַמְּגִלָּ֣ה אֲשֶׁר־ כָּתַֽבְתָּ־ מִפִּי֩ אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה בְּאָזְנֵ֥י הָעָ֛ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה בְּי֣וֹם צ֑וֹם וְגַ֨ם בְּאָזְנֵ֧י כָל־ יְהוּדָ֛ה הַבָּאִ֥ים מֵעָרֵיהֶ֖ם תִּקְרָאֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·ṯā ’at·tāh wə·qā·rā·ṯā ḇam·mə·ḡil·lāh ’ă·šer- kā·ṯaḇ·tā- mip·pî ’eṯ- diḇ·rê Yah·weh bə·’ā·zə·nê hā·‘ām bêṯ Yah·weh bə·yō·wm ṣō·wm wə·ḡam bə·’ā·zə·nê ḵāl yə·hū·ḏāh hab·bā·’îm mê·‘ā·rê·hem tiq·rā·’êm
verses.literal: so you are to go to the house of the LORD on a day of fasting and in the hearing of the people you are to read the words of the LORD from the scroll you have written at my dictation Read them in the hearing of all the people of Judah who are coming from their cities
verses.literalPt: Entra tu, pois, e pelo rolo, que tens escrito da minha boca, lê todas as palavras de Jeová aos ouvidos do povo, na casa de Jeová, no dia de jejum; também as lerás aos ouvidos de todos os de Judá que vêm das suas cidades.

verses.original: אוּלַ֞י תִּפֹּ֤ל תְּחִנָּתָם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְיָשֻׁ֕בוּ אִ֖ישׁ מִדַּרְכּ֣וֹ הָרָעָ֑ה כִּֽי־ גָד֤וֹל הָאַף֙ וְהַ֣חֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ū·lay tip·pōl tə·ḥin·nā·ṯām lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·yā·šu·ḇū ’îš mid·dar·kōw hā·rā·‘āh kî- ḡā·ḏō·wl hā·’ap̄ wə·ha·ḥê·māh ’ă·šer- dib·ber Yah·weh ’el- hā·‘ām haz·zeh
verses.literal: Perhaps they will bring their petition before the LORD and each one will turn from his wicked way for great are the anger and fury that the LORD has pronounced against this people
verses.literalPt: Pode ser que eles apresentem a sua súplica diante de Jeová e se tornem cada um do seu mau caminho; pois grande é a ira e o furor que Jeová pronunciou contra este povo.

verses.original: וַיַּ֗עַשׂ בָּרוּךְ֙ בֶּן־ נֵ֣רִיָּ֔ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֖הוּ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֑יא לִקְרֹ֥א בַסֵּ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś bā·rūḵ ben- nê·rî·yāh kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wā·hū yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî liq·rō ḇas·sê·p̄er diḇ·rê Yah·weh bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: So Baruch son of Neriah did everything that Jeremiah the prophet had commanded him In the house of the LORD he read the words of the LORD from the scroll
verses.literalPt: Fez Baruque, filho de Nerias, segundo tudo o que o profeta Jeremias lhe ordenou, lendo no livro as palavras de Jeová na casa de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י בַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַ֠חֲמִשִׁית לִיהוֹיָקִ֨ים בֶּן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָה֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁעִ֔י קָרְא֨וּ צ֜וֹם לִפְנֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם בִּירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְכָל־ הָעָ֗ם הַבָּאִ֛ים מֵעָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇaš·šā·nāh ha·ḥă·mi·šîṯ lî·hō·w·yā·qîm ben- yō·šî·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh ba·ḥō·ḏeš hat·tə·ši·‘î qā·rə·’ū ṣō·wm lip̄·nê Yah·weh kāl- hā·‘ām bî·rū·šā·lim wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām hab·bā·’îm mê·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Now in the ninth month of the fifth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah a fast before the LORD was proclaimed to all the people of Jerusalem and all . . . who had come there from the cities of Judah
verses.literalPt: Ora no quinto ano de Jeoaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, no nono mês, todo o povo em Jerusalém, e todo o povo que veio das cidades de Judá a Jerusalém, apregoaram um jejum diante de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א בָר֥וּךְ בַּסֵּ֛פֶר אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּלִשְׁכַּ֡ת גְּמַרְיָהוּ֩ בֶן־ שָׁפָ֨ן הַסֹּפֵ֜ר בֶּחָצֵ֣ר הָעֶלְי֗וֹן פֶּ֣תַח שַׁ֤עַר בֵּית־ יְהוָה֙ הֶֽחָדָ֔שׁ בְּאָזְנֵ֖י כָּל־ הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ḇā·rūḵ bas·sê·p̄er ’eṯ- diḇ·rê yir·mə·yā·hū bêṯ Yah·weh bə·liš·kaṯ gə·mar·yā·hū ḇen- šā·p̄ān has·sō·p̄êr be·ḥā·ṣêr hā·‘el·yō·wn pe·ṯaḥ ša·‘ar bêṯ- Yah·weh he·ḥā·ḏāš bə·’ā·zə·nê kāl- hā·‘ām
verses.literal: From the chamber of Gemariah son of Shaphan the scribe which was in the upper courtyard at the opening of the New Gate of the house of the LORD Baruch read from the scroll the words of Jeremiah in the hearing of all the people
verses.literalPt: Então na casa de Jeová, na câmara de Gemarias, filho do secretário Safã, no átrio superior, à entrada da porta nova da casa de Jeová, leu Baruque no livro aos ouvidos de todo o povo as palavras de Jeremias.

verses.original: וַ֠יִּשְׁמַ֗ע מִכָ֨יְהוּ בֶן־ גְּמַרְיָ֧הוּ בֶן־ שָׁפָ֛ן אֶת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל הַסֵּֽפֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ mi·ḵā·yə·hū ḇen- gə·mar·yā·hū ḇen- šā·p̄ān ’eṯ- kāl- diḇ·rê Yah·weh mê·‘al has·sê·p̄er
verses.literal: When Micaiah son of Gemariah the son of Shaphan heard all the words of the LORD from the scroll
verses.literalPt: Tendo Micaías, filho de Gemarias, filho de Safã, ouvido todas as palavras de Jeová, lidas do livro,

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤רֶד בֵּית־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ עַל־ לִשְׁכַּ֣ת הַסֹּפֵ֔ר וְהִ֨נֵּה־ שָׁ֔ם כָּל־ הַשָּׂרִ֖ים יֽוֹשְׁבִ֑ים אֱלִישָׁמָ֣ע הַסֹּפֵ֡ר וּדְלָיָ֣הוּ בֶן־ שְׁ֠מַעְיָהוּ וְאֶלְנָתָ֨ן בֶּן־ עַכְבּ֜וֹר וּגְמַרְיָ֧הוּ בֶן־ שָׁפָ֛ן וְצִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ בֶן־ חֲנַנְיָ֖הוּ וְכָל־ הַשָּׂרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·reḏ bêṯ- ham·me·leḵ ‘al- liš·kaṯ has·sō·p̄êr wə·hin·nêh- šām kāl- haś·śā·rîm yō·wō·šə·ḇîm ’ĕ·lî·šā·mā‘ has·sō·p̄êr ū·ḏə·lā·yā·hū ḇe·nōš- šə·maʿ·yā·hû wə·’el·nā·ṯān ben- ‘aḵ·bō·wr ū·ḡə·mar·yā·hū ḇen- šā·p̄ān wə·ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū ḇen- ḥă·nan·yā·hū wə·ḵāl haś·śā·rîm
verses.literal: he went down to the scribe’s . . . chamber in the king’s palace where all the officials were sitting Elishama the scribe Delaiah son of Shemaiah Elnathan son of Achbor Gemariah son of Shaphan Zedekiah son of Hananiah and all the other officials
verses.literalPt: desceu à casa do rei, à câmara do secretário. Eis que estavam ali sentados todos os príncipes: o secretário Elisama, e Delaías, filho de Semaías, e Elnatã, filho de Acbor, e Gemarias, filho de Safã, e Zedequias, filho de Hananias e todos os príncipes.

verses.original: וַיַּגֵּ֤ד לָהֶם֙ מִכָ֔יְהוּ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמֵ֑עַ בִּקְרֹ֥א בָר֛וּךְ בַּסֵּ֖פֶר בְּאָזְנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yag·gêḏ lā·hem mi·ḵā·yə·hū ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer šā·mê·a‘ biq·rō ḇā·rūḵ bas·sê·p̄er bə·’ā·zə·nê hā·‘ām
verses.literal: And Micaiah reported to them all the words he had heard Baruch read from the scroll in the hearing of the people
verses.literalPt: Micaías referiu-lhes todas as palavras que ouvira, quando Baruque leu o livro aos ouvidos do povo.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלְח֨וּ כָל־ הַשָּׂרִ֜ים אֶל־ בָּר֗וּךְ אֶת־ יְהוּדִ֡י בֶּן־ נְ֠תַנְיָהוּ בֶּן־ שֶׁלֶמְיָ֣הוּ בֶן־ כּוּשִׁי֮ לֵאמֹר֒ הַמְּגִלָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָרָ֤אתָ בָּהּ֙ בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם קָחֶ֥נָּה בְיָדְךָ֖ וָלֵ֑ךְ וַ֠יִּקַּח בָּר֨וּךְ בֶּן־ נֵרִיָּ֤הוּ אֶת־ הַמְּגִלָּה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֖א אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·lə·ḥū ḵāl haś·śā·rîm ’el- bā·rūḵ ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏî ben- nə·ṯan·yā·hū ben- še·lem·yā·hū ḇen- kū·šî lê·mōr ham·mə·ḡil·lāh ’ă·šer qā·rā·ṯā bāh bə·’ā·zə·nê hā·‘ām qā·ḥen·nāh ḇə·yā·ḏə·ḵā wā·lêḵ way·yiq·qaḥ bā·rūḵ ben- nê·rî·yā·hū ’eṯ- ham·mə·ḡil·lāh bə·yā·ḏōw way·yā·ḇō ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Then all the officials sent word to Baruch through Jehudi son of Nethaniah the son of Shelemiah the son of Cushi saying Bring . . . the scroll that you read in the hearing of the people and come here So Baruch son of Neriah took . . . the scroll and went to them
verses.literalPt: Portanto todos os príncipes enviaram Jeudi, filho de Netanias, filho de Selemias, filho de Cusi, a Baruque, para lhe dizer: Toma na tua mão o rolo de que leste aos ouvidos do povo, e vem. Tomou Baruque, filho de Nerias, o rolo na sua mão, e foi ter com eles.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו שֵׁ֣ב נָ֔א וּקְרָאֶ֖נָּה בְּאָזְנֵ֑ינוּ וַיִּקְרָ֥א בָר֖וּךְ בְּאָזְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw šêḇ nā ū·qə·rā·’en·nāh bə·’ā·zə·nê·nū way·yiq·rā ḇā·rūḵ bə·’ā·zə·nê·hem
verses.literal: Please sit down they said and read it in our hearing So Baruch read it in their hearing
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhe: Senta-te agora, e lê-o aos nossos ouvidos. Baruque o leu aos seus ouvidos.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כְּשָׁמְעָם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֔ים פָּחֲד֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־ רֵעֵ֑הוּ וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־ בָּר֔וּךְ הַגֵּ֤יד נַגִּיד֙ לַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·šā·mə·‘ām ’eṯ- kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm pā·ḥă·ḏū ’îš ’el- rê·‘ê·hū way·yō·mə·rū ’el- bā·rūḵ hag·gêḏ nag·gîḏ lam·me·leḵ ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: When they had heard all these words they turned to one another in fear and said to Baruch Surely we must report . . . all these words to the king
verses.literalPt: Tendo eles ouvido todas as palavras, voltaram-se espantados uns para os outros, e disseram a Baruque: Certamente referiremos ao rei todas estas palavras.

verses.original: וְאֶ֨ת־ בָּר֔וּךְ שָׁאֲל֖וּ לֵאמֹ֑ר הַגֶּד־ נָ֣א לָ֔נוּ אֵ֗יךְ כָּתַ֛בְתָּ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִפִּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- bā·rūḵ šā·’ă·lū lê·mōr hag·geḏ- nā lā·nū ’êḵ kā·ṯaḇ·tā ’eṯ- kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh mip·pîw
verses.literal: Tell us now they asked . . . Baruch how did you write all these words Was it at Jeremiah’s dictation
verses.literalPt: Perguntaram a Baruque: Declara-nos agora como escreveste da sua boca todas estas palavras.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ בָּר֔וּךְ מִפִּיו֙ יִקְרָ֣א אֵלַ֔י אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַאֲנִ֛י כֹּתֵ֥ב עַל־ הַסֵּ֖פֶר בַּדְּיֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·hem bā·rūḵ mip·pîw yiq·rā ’ê·lay ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh wa·’ă·nî kō·ṯêḇ ‘al- has·sê·p̄er bad·də·yōw
verses.literal: It was at his dictation Baruch replied He recited all these words to me and I wrote them in ink on the scroll
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes Baruque: Ele me referia com a sua boca todas estas palavras, e eu as escrevia no livro com tinta.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ הַשָּׂרִים֙ אֶל־ בָּר֔וּךְ לֵ֥ךְ הִסָּתֵ֖ר אַתָּ֣ה וְיִרְמְיָ֑הוּ וְאִ֥ישׁ אַל־ יֵדַ֖ע אֵיפֹ֥ה אַתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū haś·śā·rîm ’el- bā·rūḵ lêḵ his·sā·ṯêr ’at·tāh wə·yir·mə·yā·hū wə·’îš ’al- yê·ḏa‘ ’ê·p̄ōh ’at·tem
verses.literal: Then the officials said to Baruch . . . You and Jeremiah must hide yourselves and tell no one where you are
verses.literalPt: Disseram os príncipes a Baruque: Vai, esconde-te, tu e Jeremias; não saiba alguém onde estais.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤אוּ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ חָצֵ֔רָה וְאֶת־ הַמְּגִלָּ֣ה הִפְקִ֔דוּ בְּלִשְׁכַּ֖ת אֱלִישָׁמָ֣ע הַסֹּפֵ֑ר וַיַּגִּ֙ידוּ֙ בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- ham·me·leḵ ḥā·ṣê·rāh wə·’eṯ- ham·mə·ḡil·lāh hip̄·qi·ḏū bə·liš·kaṯ ’ĕ·lî·šā·mā‘ has·sō·p̄êr way·yag·gî·ḏū bə·’ā·zə·nê ham·me·leḵ ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm
verses.literal: So the officials went to the king in the courtyard And having stored the scroll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe they reported everything . . . to the king
verses.literalPt: Eles foram ao átrio ter com o rei, depois de terem depositado o rolo na câmara do secretário Elisama, e referiram todas as palavras aos ouvidos do rei.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת־ יְהוּדִ֗י לָקַ֙חַת֙ אֶת־ הַמְּגִלָּ֔ה וַיִּ֨קָּחֶ֔הָ מִלִּשְׁכַּ֖ת אֱלִישָׁמָ֣ע הַסֹּפֵ֑ר וַיִּקְרָאֶ֤הָ יְהוּדִי֙ בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּבְאָזְנֵי֙ כָּל־ הַשָּׂרִ֔ים הָעֹמְדִ֖ים מֵעַ֥ל הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏî lā·qa·ḥaṯ ’eṯ- ham·mə·ḡil·lāh way·yiq·qā·ḥe·hā mil·liš·kaṯ ’ĕ·lî·šā·mā‘ has·sō·p̄êr way·yiq·rā·’e·hā yə·hū·ḏî bə·’ā·zə·nê ham·me·leḵ ū·ḇə·’ā·zə·nê kāl- haś·śā·rîm hā·‘ō·mə·ḏîm mê·‘al ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Then the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll and he took it from the chamber of Elishama the scribe And Jehudi read it in the hearing of the king . . . and all the officials who were standing beside him
verses.literalPt: Enviou o rei a Jeudi para ir buscar o rolo; este o tirou da câmara do secretário Elisama, e o leu aos ouvidos do rei, e aos ouvidos de todos os príncipes que estavam em torno do rei.

verses.original: וְהַמֶּ֗לֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב֙ בֵּ֣ית הַחֹ֔רֶף בַּחֹ֖דֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁיעִ֑י וְאֶת־ הָאָ֖ח לְפָנָ֥יו מְבֹעָֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·me·leḵ yō·wō·šêḇ bêṯ ha·ḥō·rep̄ ba·ḥō·ḏeš hat·tə·šî·‘î wə·’eṯ- hā·’āḥ lə·p̄ā·nāw mə·ḇō·‘ā·reṯ
verses.literal: Since it was the ninth month the king was sitting in his winter quarters with a fire burning before him
verses.literalPt: Ora o rei estava sentado na casa de inverno pelo nono mês e diante dele estava um braseiro aceso.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כִּקְר֣וֹא יְהוּדִ֗י שָׁלֹ֣שׁ דְּלָתוֹת֮ וְאַרְבָּעָה֒ יִֽקְרָעֶ֙הָ֙ בְּתַ֣עַר הַסֹּפֵ֔ר וְהַשְׁלֵ֕ךְ אֶל־ הָאֵ֖שׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶל־ הָאָ֑ח עַד־ תֹּם֙ כָּל־ הַמְּגִלָּ֔ה עַל־ הָאֵ֖שׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ הָאָֽח׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kiq·rō·w yə·hū·ḏî šā·lōš də·lā·ṯō·wṯ wə·’ar·bā·‘āh yiq·rā·‘e·hā bə·ṯa·‘ar has·sō·p̄êr wə·haš·lêḵ ’el- hā·’êš ’ă·šer ’el- hā·’āḥ ‘aḏ- tōm kāl- ham·mə·ḡil·lāh ‘al- hā·’êš ’ă·šer ‘al- hā·’āḥ
verses.literal: And as soon as Jehudi had read three or four columns Jehoiakim would cut them off with a scribe’s knife and throw them into the firepot . . . - until the entire scroll had been consumed by the fire -
verses.literalPt: Tendo Jeudi lido três ou quatro folhas, cortava-as com o canivete e lançava-as no fogo que estava no braseiro, até que o rolo todo foi consumido no fogo que estava no braseiro.

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א פָחֲד֔וּ וְלֹ֥א קָרְע֖וּ אֶת־ בִּגְדֵיהֶ֑ם הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְכָל־ עֲבָדָ֔יו הַשֹּׁ֣מְעִ֔ים אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō p̄ā·ḥă·ḏū wə·lō qā·rə·‘ū ’eṯ- biḡ·ḏê·hem ham·me·leḵ wə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw haš·šō·mə·‘îm ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: Yet in hearing all these words the king and his servants did not become frightened . . . or tear their garments
verses.literalPt: Não tiveram medo nem rasgaram os seus vestidos, nem o rei nem nenhum dos seus servos que ouviram todas estas palavras.

verses.original: וְגַם֩ אֶלְנָתָ֨ן וּדְלָיָ֤הוּ וּגְמַרְיָ֙הוּ֙ הִפְגִּ֣עוּ בַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לְבִלְתִּ֥י שְׂרֹ֖ף אֶת־ הַמְּגִלָּ֑ה וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’el·nā·ṯān ū·ḏə·lā·yā·hū ū·ḡə·mar·yā·hū hip̄·gi·‘ū ḇam·me·leḵ lə·ḇil·tî śə·rōp̄ ’eṯ- ham·mə·ḡil·lāh wə·lō šā·ma‘ ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Even though Elnathan Delaiah and Gemariah urged the king not to burn the scroll he would not listen to them
verses.literalPt: Todavia Elnatã e Delaías e Gemarias tinham rogado ao rei que não queimasse o rolo; porém ele não os quis ouvir.

verses.original: וַיְצַוֶּ֣ה הַ֠מֶּלֶךְ אֶת־ יְרַחְמְאֵ֨ל בֶּן־ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וְאֶת־ שְׂרָיָ֣הוּ בֶן־ עַזְרִיאֵ֗ל וְאֶת־ שֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּֽן־ עַבְדְּאֵ֔ל לָקַ֙חַת֙ אֶת־ בָּר֣וּךְ הַסֹּפֵ֔ר וְאֵ֖ת יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֑יא וַיַּסְתִּרֵ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw·weh ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- yə·raḥ·mə·’êl ben- ham·me·leḵ wə·’eṯ- śə·rā·yā·hū ḇen- ‘az·rî·’êl wə·’eṯ- še·lem·yā·hū ben- ‘aḇ·də·’êl lā·qa·ḥaṯ ’eṯ- bā·rūḵ has·sō·p̄êr wə·’êṯ yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî way·yas·ti·rêm Yah·weh
verses.literal: Instead, the king commanded Jerahmeel a son of the king as well as Seraiah son of Azriel and Shelemiah son of Abdeel to seize Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet But the LORD had hidden them
verses.literalPt: Ordenou o rei a Jerameel, filho do rei, e a Seraías, filho de Azriel, e a Selemias, filho de Abdeel, a trazerem o escriba Baruque e o profeta Jeremias; porém Jeová os escondeu.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ אַחֲרֵ֣י׀ שְׂרֹ֣ף הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ אֶת־ הַמְּגִלָּה֙ וְאֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר כָּתַ֥ב בָּר֛וּךְ מִפִּ֥י יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū ’a·ḥă·rê śə·rōp̄ ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- ham·mə·ḡil·lāh wə·’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer kā·ṯaḇ bā·rūḵ mip·pî yir·mə·yā·hū lê·mōr
verses.literal: After the king had burned the scroll containing the words that Baruch had written at Jeremiah’s dictation the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah
verses.literalPt: Depois que o rei queimara o rolo, e as palavras que Baruque escrevera da boca de Jeremias, veio a palavra de Jeová a Jeremias, dizendo:

verses.original: שׁ֥וּב קַח־ לְךָ֖ מְגִלָּ֣ה אַחֶ֑רֶת וּכְתֹ֣ב עָלֶ֗יהָ אֵ֤ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִים֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֗וּ עַל־ הַמְּגִלָּה֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂרַ֖ף יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šūḇ qaḥ- lə·ḵā mə·ḡil·lāh ’a·ḥe·reṯ ū·ḵə·ṯōḇ ‘ā·le·hā ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·ri·šō·nîm ’ă·šer hā·yū ‘al- ham·mə·ḡil·lāh hā·ri·šō·nāh ’ă·šer śā·rap̄ yə·hō·w·yā·qîm me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Take another scroll and rewrite on it the very words that were on the original scroll which Jehoiakim king of Judah has burned
verses.literalPt: Toma de novo outro livro, e nele escreve todas as palavras primeiras que havia no primeiro livro que Jeoaquim, rei de Judá, havia queimado.

verses.original: וְעַל־ יְהוֹיָקִ֤ים מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָה֙ תֹּאמַ֔ר כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אַ֠תָּה שָׂרַ֜פְתָּ אֶת־ הַמְּגִלָּ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מַדּוּעַ֩ כָּתַ֨בְתָּ עָלֶ֜יהָ לֵאמֹ֗ר בֹּֽא־ יָב֤וֹא מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶל֙ וְהִשְׁחִית֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את וְהִשְׁבִּ֥ית מִמֶּ֖נָּה אָדָ֥ם וּבְהֵמָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- yə·hō·w·yā·qîm me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh tō·mar kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’at·tāh śā·rap̄·tā ’eṯ- ham·mə·ḡil·lāh haz·zōṯ lê·mōr mad·dū·a‘ kā·ṯaḇ·tā ‘ā·le·hā lê·mōr bō- yā·ḇō·w me·leḵ- bā·ḇel wə·hiš·ḥîṯ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ wə·hiš·bîṯ mim·men·nāh ’ā·ḏām ū·ḇə·hê·māh
verses.literal: You are to proclaim concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah that this is what the LORD says You have burned the scroll and said Why have you written on it that the king of Babylon would surely come . . . and destroy this land and deprive it of man and beast
verses.literalPt: Acerca de Jeoaquim, rei de Judá, dirás: Assim diz Jeová: Tu acabas de queimar este rolo, perguntando: Por que tens escrito nele: Certamente virá o rei de Babilônia e destruirá esta terra, e fará cessar nela homens e animais?

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עַל־ יְהֽוֹיָקִים֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה לֹא־ יִֽהְיֶה־ לּ֥וֹ יוֹשֵׁ֖ב עַל־ כִּסֵּ֣א דָוִ֑ד וְנִבְלָתוֹ֙ תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה מֻשְׁלֶ֔כֶת לַחֹ֥רֶב בַּיּ֖וֹם וְלַקֶּ֥רַח בַּלָּֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘al- yə·hō·w·yā·qîm me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh lō- yih·yeh- lōw yō·wō·šêḇ ‘al- kis·sê ḏā·wiḏ wə·niḇ·lā·ṯōw tih·yeh muš·le·ḵeṯ la·ḥō·reḇ bay·yō·wm wə·laq·qe·raḥ bal·lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD says about Jehoiakim king of Judah He will have no one to sit on David’s throne and his body will be thrown out and exposed to heat by day and frost by night
verses.literalPt: Por isso assim diz Jeová acerca de Jeoaquim, rei de Judá. Ele não terá quem se assente sobre o trono de Davi, e o seu cadáver será exposto ao calor de dia e à geada de noite.

verses.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֨י עָלָ֧יו וְעַל־ זַרְע֛וֹ וְעַל־ עֲבָדָ֖יו אֶת־ עֲוֺנָ֑ם וְהֵבֵאתִ֣י עֲ֠לֵיהֶם וְעַל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם וְאֶל־ אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֗ה אֵ֧ת כָּל־ הָרָעָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘ā·lāw wə·‘al- zar·‘ōw wə·‘al- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ’eṯ- ‘ă·wō·nām wə·hê·ḇê·ṯî ‘ă·lê·hem wə·‘al- yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim wə·’el- ’îš yə·hū·ḏāh ’êṯ kāl- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer- dib·bar·tî ’ă·lê·hem wə·lō šā·mê·‘ū
verses.literal: I will punish him and his descendants . . . and servants for their iniquity I will bring on them on the residents of Jerusalem and on the men of Judah all the calamity about which I warned them . . . but they did not listen
verses.literalPt: Castigá-lo-ei a ele, a sua linhagem e os seus servos por causa da sua iniquidade; e trarei sobre eles e sobre os habitantes de Jerusalém e sobre os homens de Judá todo o mal que pronunciei contra eles, porém não escutaram.

verses.original: וְיִרְמְיָ֜הוּ לָקַ֣ח׀ מְגִלָּ֣ה אַחֶ֗רֶת וַֽיִּתְּנָהּ֮ אֶל־ בָּר֣וּךְ בֶּן־ נֵרִיָּהוּ֮ הַסֹּפֵר֒ וַיִּכְתֹּ֤ב עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ מִפִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֣י הַסֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂרַ֛ף יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֖ה בָּאֵ֑שׁ וְע֨וֹד נוֹסַ֧ף עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם דְּבָרִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים כָּהֵֽמָּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·yir·mə·yā·hū lā·qaḥ mə·ḡil·lāh ’a·ḥe·reṯ way·yit·tə·nāh ’el- bā·rūḵ ben- nê·rî·yā·hū has·sō·p̄êr way·yiḵ·tōḇ ‘ā·le·hā mip·pî yir·mə·yā·hū ’êṯ kāl- diḇ·rê has·sê·p̄er ’ă·šer śā·rap̄ yə·hō·w·yā·qîm me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh bā·’êš wə·‘ō·wḏ nō·w·sap̄ ‘ă·lê·hem də·ḇā·rîm rab·bîm kā·hêm·māh
verses.literal: Then Jeremiah took another scroll and gave it to the scribe Baruch son of Neriah and at Jeremiah’s dictation he wrote on it all the words of the scroll that Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire And many . . . similar words were added to them
verses.literalPt: Tomou outro rolo, e o deu ao escriba Baruque, filho de Nerias, o qual escreveu nele, da boca de Jeremias, todas as palavras do livro que Jeoaquim, rei de Judá, havia queimado no fogo; e ainda se lhes acrescentaram muitas palavras semelhantes.
